title: Code Buddy
tagline: Autonomous AI coding agent using TypeSafe JEV and LiteLLM for GitHub issue resolution
overview: Code Buddy is a Python service that polls a GitHub repository for open issues, classifies each eligible issue, and routes it to a focused AI specialist. The specialists investigate the repository and open pull requests autonomously.
problem: General-purpose local coding assistants lack bounded context and safety rails when operating on repositories, leading to unpredictable changes.
solution: Built around bounded, purpose-specific agents (repo-explorer, coder, pr-agent) using GitHub API operations guarded by strict middleware and human approval flows.

architecture.diagram: GitHub -> Orchestrator -> TypeSafe JEV -> LiteLLM -> Specialist -> Guardrails -> GitHub

challenges.challenge: Agents performing unsafe operations or running destructive commands
challenges.resolution: Implemented guardrails with deterministic checks (sensitive paths, dangerous commands) and TypeSafe JEV semantic checks.

title: Spring Boot Microservices
tagline: Order, Payment, Inventory, and API Gateway with JWT & rate limiting
overview: A scalable backend system replacing a monolithic e-commerce application, built to handle flash sales and high throughput.
problem: The old monolith crashed during Black Friday sales due to database locking and tight coupling.
solution: Decomposed into Orders, Inventory, Users, and Payment services communicating asynchronously via Apache Kafka.

architecture.diagram: API Gateway -> Services -> Kafka -> Event Handlers
architecture.notes: Leveraged Kafka for event sourcing to ensure no data loss during service outages.

challenges.resolution: Implemented the Saga pattern using choreography to handle rollbacks gracefully if payment failed.

title: Medi Buddy
tagline: Hospital Hybrid RAG chatbot with strict role-based access control
overview: Medi Buddy is an intelligent RAG chatbot deployed for hospital staff, allowing doctors and nurses to query patient protocols and schedules securely.
problem: Accessing hospital protocols required navigating complex legacy systems, wasting critical time for medical staff.
solution: Built a hybrid RAG pipeline with strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), ensuring users only see data they are authorized to view.

architecture.diagram: Documents -> Text Splitter -> Embedding Model -> Pinecone <- FastAPI <- UI
architecture.notes: Uses metadata filtering in Pinecone to enforce access controls before passing context to the LLM.

challenges.challenge: Poor retrieval quality on domain-specific acronyms
challenges.resolution: Implemented hybrid search combining sparse (BM25) and dense embeddings, significantly improving recall.
